title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2610.12176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of a model on non-verifiable tasks, such as open-ended research, faces a supervision bottleneck when its outputs exceed what even human experts can reliably assess, leaving the model itself (optimizee) as the best available optimizer and evaluator. However, a single model instance struggles to critique and improve its own complex reasoning under this homogeneous loop. To address this, we propose Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS), an RSI method that alternates between evolutionary workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on self-generated trajectories. Guided by early findings that multi-agent topologies excel at complex reasoning, MASS prompts a single base model to iteratively propose, execute, and self-evaluate multi-agent workflows. translated_title: 通过多智能体自我监督实现递归式自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.12176v1 公告类型：新  摘要：模型在不可验证任务（如开放式研究）上的递归自我改进（RSI）面临一个监督瓶颈：当其输出超出即使人类专家也无法可靠评估的水平时，模型本身（即优化对象）就成为唯一可用的最佳优化器和评估器。然而，单一模型实例在这种同质化循环中难以批判并改进自身复杂的推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多智能体自我监督（MASS），这是一种在演化式工作流优化与基于自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替进行的递归自我改进方法。基于多智能体拓扑结构擅长复杂推理的早期发现，MASS促使单个基础模型迭代地提出、执行并自我评估多智能体工作流。通过受结构性护栏约束的演化搜索，模型对这些类似计算图的编排进行优化，发现最有效的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MASS方法，让单个模型在演化式多智能体工作流优化与基于自生成轨迹的监督微调之间交替进行，从而突破监督瓶颈，实现不可验证任务上的递归式自我改进。
en_tdlr: MASS enables recursive self-improvement on non-verifiable tasks by having a single base model alternate between evolutionary multi-agent workflow optimization and supervised fine-tuning on its self-generated trajectories, thereby overcoming the supervision bottleneck.
